argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$b='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
$c=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0') -TimeoutSec 12
$l=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/operator-lifecycle') -TimeoutSec 12
$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 12
$d=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments/dry-run') -TimeoutSec 12
$s=Get-Content 'E:\WebAIBridge\app\data\state.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
$cut=Get-Content 'E:\WebAIBridge\app\data\projects-live-control-plane-cutover-r42.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
Write-Output ('HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
Write-Output ('LIFECYCLE='+$l.mode)
Write-Output ('PAUSED='+$s.settings.paused)
Write-Output ('HOLD='+$cut.holdActive)
Write-Output ('SEND_ENABLED='+$c.config.allowAutonomousSend)
Write-Output ('CONTINUE_ENABLED='+$c.config.autoContinueEnabled)
Write-Output ('HIGH_REQUIRED='+$c.config.enforceHighMode)
Write-Output ('PARALLEL='+$c.config.maxParallelAgents)
Write-Output ('CHROME_REOPEN='+$c.config.openExistingChatIfMissing)
Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENTS_TOTAL='+@($a.assignments).Count)
Write-Output ('UNSETTLED='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object {$_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
Write-Output ('DRY_SEND='+$d.sendAttempted)
Write-Output ('DRY_WOULD_SEND='+@($d.rows|Where-Object {$_.wouldDispatch -eq $true}).Count)
Write-Output ('DRY_READY='+@($d.rows|Where-Object {$_.preflightReason -eq 'ready'}).Count)
$qa=@($c.config.managedChats|Where-Object {$_.role -eq 'qa' -and $_.repository -eq 'foto6/boss' -and $_.enabled -eq $true})
Write-Output ('QA_COUNT='+$qa.Count)
if($qa.Count -eq 1){$r=@($d.rows|Where-Object {$_.chatId -eq $qa[0].id});Write-Output ('QA_ROWS='+$r.Count);if($r.Count -eq 1){Write-Output ('QA_PREFLIGHT='+$r[0].preflightReason);Write-Output ('QA_TABS='+$r[0].openTabs);Write-Output ('QA_HIGH='+@($r[0].snapshots|Where-Object {$_.highMode -eq $true}).Count);Write-Output ('QA_GENERATING='+@($r[0].snapshots|Where-Object {$_.generating -eq $true}).Count)}}
Write-Output ('BACKUP_EXISTS='+(Test-Path 'E:\WebAIBridge-R65-SAFETY-BACKUP-20261014-GPT6-I1\BACKUP_MANIFEST.json'))
